adminInitFailed.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): error box when the server's database connection could not start.

initialLoadFailed.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): error box when the first load of the queue fails.

refreshFailedHttp.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): error box when refreshing the queue fails.

refreshFailed.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): error box when refreshing the queue fails.

actionFailedHttp.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): error toast when Accept/Reject/Edit/Retry/Dismiss fails.

actionFailed.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): error toast when an action fails.

acceptedToast.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): toast after accepting the AI suggestion for a chart.

rejectedToast.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): toast after rejecting the AI suggestion.

editedToast.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): toast after saving hand edits.

retryQueuedToast.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): toast after queueing a retry.
retryQueuedToast.context: {title} is the chart's title or file name.

dismissedToast.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): toast after dismissing a failed row.
dismissedToast.context: {title} is the chart's title or file name.

title.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): page heading (h1).

subtitle.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): grey line under the heading listing keyboard shortcuts.
subtitle.context: {navKeys}, {reviewKeys}, {retryKeys} are the shortcut keys shown as key caps (j/k, a/r/e, y/n); keep all three. 'Drive' = Google Drive.

filterPlaceholder.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): placeholder of the filter box; '/' is the shortcut that focuses it.

filterLabel.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): accessible name of the filter box.

refreshLabel.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): accessible name of the refresh icon button.

tabAiReview.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): tab: rows waiting for a human to review the AI's suggestion.

tabAiFailed.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): tab: rows where the AI failed after retries.

tabImportFailures.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): tab: Google Drive files that failed to import.

fieldTitle.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): small field name in the comparison table and edit form.
fieldTitle.context: Shown in CSS upper case; lower case in English on purpose.

fieldCollection.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): field name: the library collection a chart belongs to.

fieldKey.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): field name: the musical key of the chart.
fieldKey.context: Musical key (e.g. G minor), not a keyboard key.

fieldBpm.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): field name: tempo in beats per minute.

fieldLead.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): field name: the Vocal Lead / lead musician for the song.

fieldTags.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): field name: tags.

triggerNotChart.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): tiny chip on a row: the AI thinks the file is not a chart.

triggerLowConfidence.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): tiny chip: the AI's confidence is low.

triggerCollectionMismatch.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): tiny chip: the suggested collection differs from the folder.

triggerDuplicate.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): tiny chip: may be a duplicate of another chart.

triggerAiFlag.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): tiny chip: the AI itself asked for review.

dormantTitle.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): bold start of the banner when no AI key is configured.

dormantBody.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): rest of that banner.
dormantBody.context: {envVar} is the environment variable name GEMINI_API_KEY and {pendingState} is the code word 'pending'; both stay in English. 'Vercel' and 'Gemini' are product names.

calibrationTitle.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): bold start of the banner when auto-apply is off.

calibrationBody.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): rest of the calibration banner.
calibrationBody.context: {flagName} is a database setting path, {flagValue} is the word 'false' (code), {threshold} is a number like 0.70. 'Firebase Console' and 'MCP' are product names.

autoApplyTitle.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): bold start of the banner when auto-apply is on.

autoApplyBody.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): rest of the auto-apply banner.

emptyReviewTitle.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): empty AI Review tab: heading.

emptyReviewHint.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): empty AI Review tab: line under it.

selectRowHint.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): right-hand panel before a row is selected.
selectRowHint.context: {enterKey} is the Enter key shown as a key cap.

subfolderMeta.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): technical metadata line of the selected row.
subfolderMeta.context: {subfolder} is a Drive folder id (shortened). Keep it terse.

acceptButton.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): button that applies the AI suggestion; (a) is its keyboard shortcut.

editButton.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): button that opens the edit form; (e) is its shortcut.

rejectButton.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): button that rejects the suggestion; (r) is its shortcut.

columnCurrent.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): heading of the column with the chart's current values.

columnSuggestion.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): heading of the column with the AI's suggested values.

noChange.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): suggested value when the AI proposes no new title.

advisoryOnly.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): suggested collection when the AI only advises.

noSuggestion.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): shown when a row has no AI suggestion.

concernsLabel.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): label before the AI's list of concerns.

duplicatesLabel.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): label before the list of possible duplicate charts.

noChanges.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): toast when the edit form is saved without changes.

editHeading.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): heading of the edit form.

save.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): edit form: save button.

cancelButton.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): edit form: cancel button; (esc) is its shortcut.

tagsPlaceholder.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): edit form: placeholder of the tags box.

tagsLabel.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): edit form: accessible name of the tags box.

emptyFailedTitle.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): empty AI Failed tab: heading.

emptyFailedHint.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): empty AI Failed tab: line under it.

attemptsTried.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): AI Failed row: how many times the AI tried.
attemptsTried.context: {count} is a number. The English one-form is kept exactly as the page showed before translation.

retryButton.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): row button that retries; (y) is its shortcut.

dismissButton.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): row button that dismisses; (n) is its shortcut.

emptyImportTitle.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): empty Import Failures tab: heading.

emptyImportHint.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): empty Import Failures tab: line under it.

hintNavigate.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): bottom shortcut bar: what j/k does.

hintExpand.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): bottom shortcut bar: what Enter does.

hintFilter.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): bottom shortcut bar: what / does.

hintAccept.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): bottom shortcut bar: what a does.

hintReject.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): bottom shortcut bar: what r does.

hintEdit.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): bottom shortcut bar: what e does.

hintRetry.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): bottom shortcut bar: what y does.

hintDismiss.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): bottom shortcut bar: what n does.

hintCancel.where: Admin-only page /manage/library-review (AI review queue for chart metadata): bottom shortcut bar: what Esc does.
